args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Response: rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. The first rollback attempt partially failed (only us-east completed due to an orchestrator error); a retry completed us-west and eu-west. Post-rollback status verified healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions with a 0.2% error rate. Follow-up needed: root-cause the regression introduced in v2.3.1 and investigate the orchestrator rollback failure before re-attempting the release.

**Summary:**
- **Diagnosis:** checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
- **Rollback:** Rolled back all production regions to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that was healthy in production. The first attempt partially failed (only us-east completed due to an orchestrator error); a retry successfully completed us-west and eu-west.
- **Verification:** checkout-api is now healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions with a 0.2% error rate.
- **Incident:** Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** for checkout-api documenting the failure, the rollback actions (including the orchestrator issue), and follow-up items — root-causing the v2.3.1 regression and investigating the rollback orchestrator failure. The on-call engineer has been paged.
